# reTerminal and reTerminal DM FAQ

This page contains verified answers for the reTerminal and reTerminal DM.

## Hardware & Interfaces {#hardware-and-interfaces}

### Which device tree overlay enables the reTerminal bridge? {#reterminal-bridge-overlay}

**Applies to:** reTerminal and reTerminal DM running Raspberry Pi OS

**Last verified:** 2026-11-10

The reTerminal bridge overlay is enabled with `dtoverlay=reTerminal-bridge`.

**Notes:**

- Commenting the line out restores the LED and buzzer behaviour.
